The '''2018–19 Tahiti Ligue 1''' is the 72nd season of the [[Tahiti Ligue 1]], the top-flight [[Association football|football]] league in [[Tahiti]]. The season started on 28 September 2018.<ref>[https://www.rsssf.org/tablest/tahiti2019.html French Polynesia 2018/19], RSSSF.com</ref> [[A.S. Central Sport]] are the defending champions. Many league games took place in front of dozens of spectators.

==Relegation playoff==
The winner of the relegation playoff between [[A.S. Arue|Arue]] (Ligue 1 9th place) and [[A.S. Olympique de Mahina|Olympique de Mahina]] (Ligue 2 2nd place) earned a place in the [[2019–20 Tahiti Ligue 1]].

{{Football box

|time       =
